name: Recall@10
one_line: Proportion of queries where at least one chunk graded 2 or higher appears in the top 10.

formula.notation: R@k = |{ q in Q : max grade(c) >= 2 for c in top_k(q) }| / |Q|

terms.meaning: graded relevance 0-3 from the golden set
the k chunks the retriever ranked highest for q

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
